name: GGX Specular Shading
definition: Shades a voxel surface using a Cook-Torrance microfacet model with GGX specular, Lambertian diffuse from irradiance cache, and dielectric transmission handling.
summary: GGX Specular Shading is a path-tracing method for voxel rendering that combines Cook-Torrance microfacets with GGX reflection, diffuse irradiance, and dielectric transmission, providing a complete shading loop rather than just BRDF components.
